context:
Goal: price a live listing by typing it on the one list.
Problem (rule): today a typed price on a live listing, sent with no new copy, is refused. Item 37 approved kept suggestions only, so allowing typed prices opens that refusal again for an act you have not named.
Based on (ruling): your item 37 'merge' answer.
Based on (read): the spec line 'one send takes new copies, kept suggestions and typed prices'.
Pricing builds it as a separate commit, held out of the batch until you answer.
Your question (2026-11-02 15:53 CST, "is there a bug?"): you are right, and the line "today ... is refused" was wrong. On main today, the Live tab sends a typed price on a live listing with no new copy, as a price-only row (cli/cmd_emit, app/src/SendCard). The refusal is only in the new one-list wire the pricing lane is building, which replaces the Live tab. So "Keep the refusal" would take away something you can do today. Triage read main; the owning session confirms against the lane's branch.
home: coordinator handoff, Rulings (process-only); pricing-suggest lane lands the two held commits

options.gain: The one list does what the spec says.
options.how: A typed live price goes out like a kept suggestion, under the same checks: a fresh price reading and the cap.
options.label: Allow it
options.lose: One more way past the refusal.

options.how: Typed live prices go out only with new copies in the same send.
options.label: Keep the refusal
options.lose: Repricing one listing needs a new copy alongside, or a kept suggestion instead.

title: May a typed price on a live listing go out by itself?
why: Same checks as kept suggestions, and it is what the spec already promises.
